tax_name: None (no VAT, GST or sales tax)
legal_ref: No VAT/GST legislation; direct taxes under the Inland Revenue Ordinance (Cap. 112)
quote: "There is no sales tax or VAT, withholding tax, capital gains tax, estate tax or tax on dividends in Hong Kong." (Brand Hong Kong, HKSAR Government); hkengage.gov.hk: "Simple Tax Regime No sales tax, VAT, capital gains tax, dividend tax, estate tax, or withholding tax on dividends and interest."
source_title: Brand Hong Kong (HKSAR Government) 'Unique advantages'; also https://www.hkengage.gov.hk/en/why-hk/work/low-tax-advantage
notes: No general consumption tax. Hong Kong is a free port; excise duties only on specific goods (liquor, tobacco, hydrocarbon oil, methyl alcohol). GovHK Public Finance factsheet (May 2026) lists other levies: hotel accommodation tax 3% from 1 January 2025, stamp duty, betting duty, rates, motor-vehicle first registration tax. A 2006 GST consultation was not pursued.
unverified: Statement that the 2006 GST consultation was shelved is not sourced from a fetched official text
